description: Source code implementing USB device configuration management functions for Zephyr OS, including configuration retrieval, setting, resetting, and attribute management.

methods.name: usbd_config_get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration node matching the given configuration value from the context.

methods.name: usbd_config_get_current
methods.description: Returns the current active configuration node if the device is configured.

methods.name: usbd_config_classes_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables all classes within a given configuration node.

methods.name: usbd_config_reset
methods.description: Resets the current configuration to the addressed state, shutting down endpoints and disabling classes.

methods.name: usbd_config_exist
methods.description: Checks if a specific configuration exists in the current device context.

methods.name: usbd_config_set
methods.description: Sets a new configuration, resetting previous if necessary, and enabling associated classes.

methods.name: usbd_config_attrib_rwup
methods.description: Enables or disables remote wakeup attribute for a configuration.

methods.name: usbd_config_attrib_self
methods.description: Enables or disables self-powered attribute for a configuration.

methods.name: usbd_config_maxpower
methods.description: Sets the maximum power attribute for a configuration.

methods.name: usbd_add_configuration
methods.description: Adds a new configuration node to the device context, handling feature support and re-insertion.
